highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews the Skia m154 renderer and refreshed package XML documentation.
highlights_body: HarfBuzzSharp bindings now follow the bundled native source, with one renamed enum member and one removed aggregate flag.

breaking.title: UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 was renamed
breaking.body: The misspelled CCC133 member is now CCC132, matching upstream HarfBuzz; its numeric value remains 132. Update source code that refers to CCC133.

breaking.title: GlyphFlags.Defined was removed
breaking.body: The aggregate flag mask is no longer exposed because it is not an independent option. Combine the concrete GlyphFlags values your application requires instead.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 154 and includes subsequent upstream browser and buffer-upload fixes.
NuGet packages now carry compiler-generated XML documentation sidecars, with API documentation sourced from C# comments.

contributor_summaries.azchohfi: Improved the Windows build configuration for the bundled HarfBuzzSharp native library

preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9: Preview 1 opened the 4.154 line with the Skia m154 engine update.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp bindings are now generated from the HarfBuzz source pinned by Skia, keeping supported managed declarations synchronized with version 14.2.1.

v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m154 engine update.
v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.body: It also begins shipping compiler-generated XML documentation with the NuGet packages.
